summary: Structural fix for F2 (T77d): deterministic server-side rendering of all run_probe questions into the SSE stream as a delta, playbook rewritten so the model only adds a short invitation line.
final_report:
T77e done - structural fix for F2 landed, compileall clean, pytest tests/test_api_chat_sse.py -q = 15 passed / 1 failed where the single failure is test_turn_rejects_missing_config (the documented oc-issues #34 env failure, named verbatim in T46/T71/T75 records), no commit per task spec.

WHAT CHANGED
(1) app/llm/tools.py (+12): new pure function render_probe_questions(questions: list[dict]) -> str - deterministic markdown: heading '**Quick check — let's see where you're starting from.**', each question numbered '1.'/'2.'... with options as three-space-indented 'A) <option>' lines (letter derived by index from the stripped options list, option strings whitespace-stripped), final line "Reply like `1: B` — or say you don't know and I'll teach through it." No LLM involvement; module-level so importable directly.
(2) app/services/sessions/turn.py (+8 incl. import): in the agentic loop immediately after `yield tool_event` for run_probe executions that succeeded (no error key AND non-empty questions list), the rendered block is yielded as ONE delta event and appended to buffer - so it is part of the persisted assistant message and streams before the model continues (its invitation line lands after). Placement is inline in the per-execution branch, so exactly once per successful run_probe execution; failed probes (error key) or empty question lists emit nothing.
(3) app/llm/messages.py (-2/+3 net +1 line count): PHASE_PLAYBOOK probe section - both model-facing presentation sentences removed ('Present its questions as numbered graded multiple-choice items (options A-D) ONE OR TWO AT A TIME, conversationally.' and T77c's 'Present EVERY question returned by run_probe — never silently drop any.') replaced with the mandated clause: 'After calling run_probe, the server displays all questions to the learner automatically. Do NOT restate, reformat, or re-list them; write only one short line inviting their answers (e.g. 'Take your time — answer what you can').' Keeping the old present-it-yourself sentences would have contradicted the new do-not-restate rule, so both went. Grading/pending-questions machinery from T77c untouched.
(4) tests/test_api_chat_sse.py (+25/-1): the scripted run_probe flow in test_second_turn_system_prompt_carries_lesson_state now asserts, after the tool_result event: the very next SSE event is a delta containing 'Quick check' with exactly three 'A)' and three 'B)' option markers (question count) plus the verbatim reply-format footer; and the persisted ls5 assistant message content contains both the block heading and the 'Reply like' footer. The stale T77c assertion on the removed sentence was updated to assert 'the server displays all questions to the learner automatically' in the follow-up turn's system prompt.

VERIFICATION: python -m compileall -q app tests -> OK; python -m pytest tests/test_api_chat_sse.py -q -> 15 passed, 1 failed (#34 env only). Rendered block sanity-checked via direct call: em dashes are real U+2014 (console '?' rendering is the known codepage artifact). LSP diagnostics on turn.py are pre-existing TurnMixin duck-typing artifacts, unchanged by this task.

HANDOFF NOTE FOR MERLIN: auto-reload applies live on http://raspberrypi.local:8000/. Live re-run should show, on turn-1 of a fresh session: tool_call run_probe -> tool_result 'probe ready: N questions' -> delta starting '**Quick check — let's see where you're starting from.**' listing ALL N questions -> short model invitation only (no re-listed items). F2 acceptance: presented-question count == returned count == persisted-content marker count.
